label: def:algebraic-quantum-volume
title: Algebraic quantum volume $\mathrm{Vol}_q(K)$
html:
Let W \in H_n(q) be a knot operator representing a confined state. The algebraic quantum volume of W is its full canonical Markov trace, an element of \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}][(q^{2}+1)^{-1}] at z = q^{3}/(q^{2}+1):

  \mathrm{Vol}_{\mathrm{alg}}(W)
  \;:=\; \mathrm{tr}_M(W)
  \;=\; \sum_{\lambda \vdash n} W_\lambda \, t_\lambda(W)

where W_\lambda are the quantum dimensions and t_\lambda(W) are the irreducible character traces.

The channel-decomposition structure of the sum, and the fact that the algebraic volume computes within the categorical substrate before any evaluation at q_0, are developed in the follow-on remark.
